title: Qualify audit-engine immutable-evidence protection adversarially and in CI
objective: Execute the ENG-07.6 evidence-protection validator, add focused synthetic attacks against write authority, validator source safety, AWU scope isolation and remediation-queue authority, and wire exactly two checks into the existing bootstrap.
non_goals: replace or edit canonical historical evidence protection
modify protected evidence business code contracts data/audit or certified reports
change protection semantics except to fix a demonstrated validator defect

required_invariants: canonical historical evidence protection remains byte-untouched by WU02
validator --check and --self-check execute in bootstrap before WU completion
adversarial tests cover writable authority permission drift dangerous imports write primitives protected scope queue write fields canonical binding and Lot45/Lot46 isolation
CI adds exactly the evidence-protection check and adversarial test steps without a new workflow
no dependency installation network access or paid service is introduced
any validator correction remains inside the WU01 policy/validator family and preserves fail-closed semantics
acceptance_criteria: validator --check passes against canonical protection and current ENG-07 scopes
adversarial suite passes with at least 16 focused probes
writable mutation authority or findings/report permission fails closed
dangerous import or filesystem write primitive in any audit validator fails closed
ENG-07 AWU access to protected path or forbidden business/evidence prefix fails closed
remediation queue command patch target-path branch or write-authority field fails closed
canonical protection path kind comparison base anchor or protected-path drift remains fail closed through the canonical validator
bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on the same exact head

done_when: audit evidence protection validator and adversarial suite pass on exact head in bootstrap
Security Secrets passes on the same exact head
canonical historical evidence protection and all frozen evidence remain unmodified
ENG-07 can be closed and transition to ENG-08 planning without unlocking business development
